name: Ikaruga F Subarusky
original_name: 斑鳩・F・スバルスカイ
source:
Age: not bound by such a thing as age
Likes: one who charms others has no such thing as likes
Skills: stopping time, manipulating flames, charming women
Role: the king who rules over all

A dodgy-looking guy who suddenly appeared in the streets of Asakusa. Calling himself the king of violet flames, this arrogant person is always looking down on others. Controlling azure and scarlet flames, his magic power is infinite. In addition, he can use time-stopping ability known as "time interference," bringing even light to a halt and turning the world monochromatic.

[Translated from [url=http://oreowa.jp/character/ikaruga.html]the official site[/url]]
